=== verify Dockerfile ===
FROM python:3.10

# Install system dependencies required by podman and the test suite
RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
        podman \
        crun \
        runc \
        fuse-overlayfs \
        git \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure podman to use the vfs storage driver (works without overlayfs in
# constrained/rootless environments)
RUN mkdir -p /etc/containers \
    && cp /usr/share/containers/storage.conf /etc/containers/storage.conf \
    && sed -i 's/driver = "overlay"/driver = "vfs"/' /etc/containers/storage.conf

# Install Python testing dependencies
RUN pip install --upgrade pip \
    && pip install pytest

# Clone the repository and place it in /repo
RUN git clone https://github.com/containers/podman-compose.git
RUN mkdir /repo
RUN git config --global --add safe.directory /repo
RUN cp -r /podman-compose/. /repo && rm -rf /podman-compose/

# Install project + test dependencies
RUN pip install -r /repo/requirements.txt -r /repo/test-requirements.txt

WORKDIR /repo

CMD ["pytest", "/repo", "--collect-only", "-q"]
